# Vendored `@deno/loader`

This directory is a patched copy of [`@deno/loader`](https://jsr.io/@deno/loader) **0.5.0**,
generated by `scripts/vendor-loader.ts`. Do not edit it by hand: change the script and run
`node scripts/vendor-loader.ts 0.5.0` from `packages/unplugin-deno/`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/denoland/deno-js-loader (MIT, see `LICENSE`)
- Package: `@jsr/deno__loader@0.5.0` from https://npm.jsr.io
- Tarball: https://npm.jsr.io/~/11/@jsr/deno__loader/0.5.0.tgz

Only the Node.js code path is vendored; `src/lib/rs_lib.js` (Deno-only Wasm ESM import), the
TypeScript sources, the Rust sources and source maps are omitted.

## Patches

- `mod.js`: Always load the wasm through `rs_lib_node.js` (`readFileSync` + synchronous `WebAssembly.Module`/`Instance`) on every runtime, instead of `import * as wasm from "./rs_lib.wasm"` when `typeof Deno !== "undefined"`. The Deno-only `lib/rs_lib.js` is not vendored. Asserted pattern (x1): `/let _lib;\s*if \(typeof Deno !== "undefined"\) \{\s*_lib = await import\("\.\/lib\/rs_lib\.js"\);\s*\} else \{\s*_lib = await import\("\.\/rs_lib_node\.js"\);\s*\}/`
- `mod.js`: Route the `debug: true` output of `Loader` (`console.error`) to `emitDebug`. Asserted pattern (x5): `console.error(`
- `mod.js`: Drop the `sourceMappingURL` comment (the map and `mod.ts` are not vendored). Asserted pattern (x1): `/\n\/\/# sourceMappingURL=mod\.js\.map\s*$/`
- `mod.js`: Point Deno at the declarations with `@ts-self-types` (JSR type-checks the published dist). Asserted pattern (x1): `/^/`
- `mod.d.ts`: Drop the `sourceMappingURL` comment (the map is not vendored). Asserted pattern (x1): `/\n?\/\/# sourceMappingURL=mod\.d\.ts\.map\s*$/`
- `mod.d.ts`: Declare the `[Symbol.dispose](): void` members of `Workspace` and `Loader` after their constructors, as `mod.ts` does: the generated declarations drop them, so `implements Disposable` fails type checking (TS2420) when Deno checks this file, which `deno publish` does for the JSR package. Asserted pattern (x2): `/( implements Disposable \{\n[^\n]*\bconstructor\([^)\n]*\);\n)(?!\s*\[Symbol\.dispose\])/`
- `lib/rs_lib.internal.js`: Import the hooks module. Asserted pattern (x1): `/^import \{ fetch_specifier \} from "\.\/snippets\/rs_lib-[0-9a-f]+\/helpers\.js";$/m`
- `lib/rs_lib.internal.js`: Route Rust panic messages (`console_error_panic_hook`, `console.error(String)`) to the logger as `kind: "panic"`. Asserted pattern (x1): `/console\.error\(getStringFromWasm0\(arg0, arg1\)\);/`
- `lib/rs_lib.internal.js`: Route Rust `log` records (`<LEVEL> RS - …`) and reporter lines (`Blocking …`, `Initialize …`) to the logger. Asserted pattern (x1): `/(export function __wbg_error_[0-9a-f]+\(arg0\) \{\s*)console\.error\(arg0\);/`
- `lib/snippets/rs_lib-aa8c88480f363a4a/helpers.js`: Import the hooks module. Asserted pattern (x1): `/^export async function fetch_specifier\(/m`
- `lib/snippets/rs_lib-aa8c88480f363a4a/helpers.js`: Route `console.error("Downloading", url)` to the logger as `kind: "download"`. Asserted pattern (x1): `console.error("Downloading", specifier);`
- `lib/snippets/rs_lib-aa8c88480f363a4a/helpers.js`: Fetch through the injectable fetch (default `globalThis.fetch` at call time) with 3 jittered retries on network errors, HTTP 429 and HTTP 5xx (upstream has no retries). Asserted pattern (x1): `const response = await fetch(specifier, options);`

## Added files

- `hooks.js` / `hooks.d.ts`: `setLogger(fn)` and `setFetch(fn)` injection points used by the
  patched glue (default: no output, `globalThis.fetch`). Source: `scripts/deno-loader-overlay/`.
- `VERSION`, `NOTICE.md`: provenance.
